  <h2>Frequently asked questions</h2>
  <h3>How does this TCO calculator work?</h3>
  <p>Pick a scenario (50 / 200 / 1,000 VMs or custom), up to three competitors and a region. The model prices exactly three articles: software (licenses + vendor support from sourced data), one-time migration (VMs × $/VM) and personnel (a days-per-month staffing model). Hardware and facilities are identical on both sides and excluded. Every default shows its source, date and source nature.</p>
  <h3>Does Cozystack always win?</h3>
  <p>No — and the calculator says so. Against low-cost open-source support subscriptions (Proxmox, OpenStack, CloudStack) Cozystack is more expensive at default assumptions; the result card turns red and says it openly. Cozystack wins where expensive per-core licensing dominates — VMware VCF/VVF, Nutanix. Publishing the losing cases is part of the methodology.</p>
  <h3>Where do the prices come from?</h3>
  <p>Vendor list prices, third-party reported street prices (always labeled), and derived estimates — each figure carries its source and date, pinned to Q3 2026 with dataset v0.2.0. Found an inaccuracy? We correct within 10 business days and keep a public changelog.</p>
  <h3>Can I get the result as a document?</h3>
  <p>Yes — the calculator exports a PDF with the full breakdown, a diff of everything you changed against defaults, a sensitivity analysis and the complete source appendix. No email required to see results.</p>
